b: A look back at what we were talking about around this time in previous years:
how should I manage someone who uses the Gen Z stare?
I now realize a work friendship wasn’t healthy — where do I go from here?
how do I deal with the two-faced manager who laid me off?
my team member won’t stop talking about their Keto diet
I’m frustrated that my coworkers with kids work less than me, but I don’t want to cut back
our ex-CEO’s son can’t do his job and is overpaid
does using humor risk undermining me as a manager?
I’m in trouble for badging in, then going back home
my boss wouldn’t work with me because she was upset I adopted from foster care
my new boss scolded us about our private chat messages
I get angry when I’m praised for doing work I don’t like
I work at Twitter … what do I do?
we have to thank our coworkers for coming to work
my VP of HR says my service dog is too small
my team is requiring us to do a diet/exercise/”mental toughness” program
I lied to get a job and can’t let go of the guilt
can I refuse to meet with my boss until he sends an agenda?
can I read erotica on work breaks?
the men in our office use the women’s bathrooms … only for pooping
I turned down a job offer and now the recruiter is invoicing me
my whole team is going to resign at once
